name: Page Visit Counter Analytics – Google Analytics Alternative for WordPress
author: Ankit Panchal

sections.description:
Page Visit Counter Analytics is a lightweight, privacy-first analytics plugin for WordPress. Track visitor sessions, analyze top pages, measure bounce rate, monitor traffic sources, and view real-time stats—right inside your WordPress dashboard.

Unlike bloated analytics tools, this plugin is built for speed and compliance. No cookies. No tracking pixels. Just clean, powerful insights from your WordPress site—without slowing it down.

Perfect for bloggers, marketers, WooCommerce stores, and anyone who wants actionable analytics without relying on Google Analytics or external services.

🔥 Why Choose Page Visit Counter Analytics?
– Built for privacy – no cookies, no PII, fully GDPR/CCPA-ready
– Real-time visitor stats and session analytics
– Track page views, bounce rate, session duration, and pages per session
– UTM campaign tracking with full summary and source grouping
– Goal tracking & conversion analytics (Pro)
– Lightweight: No impact on site speed
– 100% self-hosted, no 3rd-party servers or APIs

Features

  • 📊 Visitor Analytics: View daily visits, top pages, devices, browsers, and countries
  • ⚡ Real-Time Stats: See who’s visiting your site right now
  • 🔍 Traffic Sources: Discover how visitors find your site (referrers, UTM, direct)
  • 🎯 Campaign Tracking: Full UTM support to track marketing efforts (Pro)
  • 🧭 Session-Level Insights: Track session duration, bounce rate, pages/session
  • ✅ Goal Completions: Set and monitor conversion goals (Pro)
  • 🔥 Click Heatmaps: Visualize visitor clicks on each page (Pro)
  • 🔒 Privacy First: No cookies, fully compliant with privacy laws
  • 🚀 Fast & Lightweight: Zero impact on page load times
  • 🧩 Easy to Use: No configuration needed. Just activate and get insights instantly.

Migration from Advanced Page Visit Counter

If you’re upgrading from Advanced Page Visit Counter, your data will be automatically migrated to Page Visit Counter Analytics. The migration process:

  • Preserves all your existing page visit data
  • Maintains historical analytics
  • Transfers your settings and configurations
  • Keeps your custom tracking rules

The migration happens automatically when you activate Page Visit Counter Analytics. No manual steps required!

Migration from Advanced Page Visit Counter

If you’re switching from Advanced Page Visit Counter, here’s what you need to know:

  1. Data Migration

    • Your existing visit counts will be automatically migrated
    • Historical data will be preserved
    • No manual data transfer needed

  2. Key Differences

    • Enhanced privacy features
    • Improved performance
    • More detailed analytics
    • Better dashboard interface
    • No cookie dependency

  3. Migration Steps

    • Install and activate Page Visit Counter Analytics
    • Deactivate Advanced Page Visit Counter
    • Your data will be automatically migrated
    • Visit the new dashboard to verify the migration

  4. Post-Migration

    • Review your settings in the new plugin
    • Update any custom shortcodes if used
    • Check your analytics dashboard for data accuracy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Visit Visit Counter > Dashboard to see analytics
  4. Configure tracking options under Visit Counter > Settings
sections.faq:
Is this plugin GDPR-compliant?

Yes. We take privacy seriously. The plugin:
– Doesn’t use cookies
– Doesn’t send data to third-party services
– Uses hashed IP addresses
– Collects only essential analytics data
– Is fully self-hosted

How does the tracking work?

The plugin uses a lightweight tracking system that:
– Tracks sessions and pageviews in real-time
– Uses session and IP hashes for anonymous tracking
– Doesn’t impact your site’s performance
– Works without external scripts or cookies

Can I customize what gets tracked?

Yes! You can:
– Exclude specific user roles
– Block specific IPs
– Track only logged-in users
– Select which post types to track
– Enable/disable specific metrics

Does it support custom post types?

Yes, you can choose which post types to track through the settings panel.

How does the GeoIP feature work?

The plugin uses MaxMind’s GeoLite2 database for country-level geolocation:
– Database is stored locally
– Updates automatically
– Only determines country of origin
– No personal data is sent to third parties
